_README: This file is INTENTIONALLY BLANK. Nothing here was inferred from your CV.
While profile_configured is false, the matcher runs in relevance-only mode:
it scores role fit, location, work type and eligibility, caps every score at
60, and leaves strengths/missing_skills EMPTY rather than guessing. The
workbook says 'UNSCORED - profile not configured' so you are never shown a
match percentage that no evidence supports.
To fill it in, either edit this file by hand or run:
pipenv run python main.py profile --from-cv "<path to CV or CV library>"
which produces a draft you review before it takes effect. Set
profile_configured to true once you are happy with it.
where evidence is one of: demonstrated | professional | project | coursework |
as full evidence when scoring. Never list a skill you cannot point at.
